name: ecsodus
description: Migrate AWS Copilot CLI apps to Terraform in place, without deleting production. Activate this power before any Copilot stack deletion (copilot app/env/svc delete or deleting Copilot CloudFormation stacks): a plain delete destroys certificates, DNS records, load balancers, EFS and databases. Read-only assessment, Terraform import blocks, retain patches and a gated runbook.
